# C4 Level 2 — Container Diagram

This folder contains the output from the `/c4-container` skill.

## Contents (generated by agent)

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `container-diagram.md` | Container document with service inventory, data store table, Kafka topics, communication matrix, Mermaid C4Container diagram |
| `container-diagram.drawio` | draw.io XML version of the Container diagram |

## Run `/c4-container` to generate these files (requires `/approve c4-context` first).
